name: hercules-pro
description: An animated ChatGPT financial teacher grounded in your live Hearth ledgers.

interface.shortDescription: Ask your Hearth books in ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Hercules Pro investigates posted Personal and Household facts, teaches the accounting idea, and appears as a living 3D companion beside ChatGPT. Reading is the default; an opted-in member may post one exact preview only after direct confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Can I afford groceries this week?
Explain where our household money went this month.
Teach me what my card balance means.
